description: This file defines the KpiSummaryModel class within the OrangeHRM performance API module. The class is responsible for serializing reviewer rating entities, exposing KPI summary information through a specified API schema. It uses traits for serialization and implements a normalizable interface.

classes.name: KpiSummaryModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing KPI summary data related to reviewer ratings, exposing properties like id, title, minRating, and maxRating.
